question: Which biological processes involve the proteins that ibuprofen binds?
raw: The lines show ibuprofen binding to Aldo-keto reductase family 1 member C3, Prostaglandin G/H synthase 1 and 2, Solute carrier family 22 member 6, and Arachidonate 5-lipoxygenase [1-30]. Associated biological processes include prostaglandin biosynthesis, inflammatory response, fever generation, steroid metabolism, leukotriene biosynthesis, and organic anion transport [1-30]. All links are supported by curated Gene Ontology annotations and experimental ChEMBL 37 activity or mechanism data [1-30]. The lines do not show statistical, text-mined, or predicted associations, nor do they establish causality or quantify the effect of ibuprofen on these processes [1-30].
